the vertical's wides hold far comic cumulus: a towering bank on the horizon rising behind the hedge (not at dusk) and six loose clouds through the upper sky, sky-tinted flat fills with a halftone underside, ink on the shadow side and a cyan/magenta misregistration, drifting on ones and continuous across cuts; gated to the full tall picture with a deep sky, so the landscape (including the stalk page's tall panels) and the end page's panels are unchanged; the vertical close-ups (the alarm eye, the dog's face, the rabbit's eye) keep them behind the face, fringed out of focus, on purpose
the sticker freeze cuts in fully formed (it only breathes), so the rabbit stays on its square and the caption never lands on the rabbit
the overhead top views have legs splaying on twos, and the fox big ink-tipped ears and white cheeks, so it reads as a fox and not a carrot
the tumble cloud is tan dust with the dog's black floppy ear and white tail poking out, so it reads as the dog, not a sheep
